actor_objective.definition: mean(normalized clipped exp(detached conservative Twin log1p Query J50) * conservative Twin log1p Query J50)

gradient_contract.optimizer: one raw full-fit negative parameter-gradient direction; no Adam state, momentum, weight decay, or Query analytic gradient
gradient_contract.base_checkpoint: each seed's K4 inner-selected Actor and paired selected Twin Critics

step_contract.calibration: deterministic scalar bisection until full-fit Actor output RMS equals the target
step_contract.forcing_scope: one-step diagnostic only; exact matching is not the later continuous-OAC cap-only rule

evaluation_contract.base: the frozen K4 selected Actor at the same seed
evaluation_contract.external_reference: deterministic warm center evaluated by the same frozen Query
evaluation_contract.selection: diagnostic mean-response curve only; no step is automatically promoted to a long-run LR or cap

routing.mean_response_unsaturated: pooled gain versus K4 base is strictly increasing from 0.005 through 0.02 sigma and the 0.02 step improves mean in at least two of three seeds
routing.interior_mean_optimum: the pooled best mean-gain step is below 0.02 sigma
routing.no_reliable_direction: no step improves mean in at least two of three seeds
routing.tail_role: P05/worst and speed slices are mandatory evidence for the long-curve preregistration but do not retroactively redefine this one-step mechanism diagnostic

independent_validation: reload source checkpoints, reconstruct gamma1 weights/gradient, recalibrate every step, replay base and stepped inner Query costs, and recompute routing
